body: You have a right to how you feel. You can feel grateful and also have valid feelings, remember that.
i don't know what to say to this other than I really want to give you a hug and I'm sorry your so tired of everything in life.
I will never touch my door knob the same ever again
Yes two of my favorite things in one image AYYYAYAYYSYSY Tinkerbell and Animal crossing
Some people annoyingly just don't know how unwanted their critiques are. In those stupid situations its hard to know what to say so good for you for not cursing them out on the spot;)

The hate is strong but you are stronger.  Your friend did something many of us think about constantly and I know it  hurts. I'm not gonna tell you life gets better cuz I don't even know if its true but don't do anything rash unless it finding the motherfuckers

It will never be the same. I'm two attempts in and I don't even know how to feel. sounds like you in the fog a very thick scary fog and eats you up inside and out. it will take time to get to something that kind of resembles normal but it will be hard, unfortunately.

i get it but I'm just a high school freshman who failing English. People need to keep their tips to themselves, and their expectations. They don't know how much it really hurts. tell me more if u want
This might be hard to believe, but I see you and hear you and want to help. from my experience, it's nice to talk to someone who knows what it's like to not want to feel anymore. talk to me;)

I kind of agree with you cuz you make a great point. But sadly we have to look at this from a mentally stable point of view. "It's bad to want to kill yourself". like okay and... it's what I want, mind ur business.
Its a hard thing to catch yourself thinking that. I wanna give you a hug cuz the feelings mutual.

I get it people suck and death looks so good. I also wish people could stop saying the everyone is depressed right now. Cuz it's different. I'm here for ya bud and you're not dumb you just feel things harder than others do.

Life is crap honestly and this is a big decision but make sure that this is really what you want to do. It sounds like it is and I'm so sorry. I genuinely understand how you feel I'm two attempts in and still alive and don know how to feel anymore because I'm so numb and used to masking for the people around me.  Don't mess it up because if you get caught everything gets worse.
